explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/557 (Erdős–Graham): is R_k(T) ≤ kn + O(1) for every tree T on n vertices? It is implied by the Erdős–Sós conjecture (Problem 548), whose page now records a full proof, and Reed–Stein's dense case gives large n. The statement asserts an absolute c with multicolourGraphRamsey k T ≤ kn + c for all k, n and trees on Fin n, with a linked Lean proof. Faithful.
